movers.text: QB Kirk Cousins expected to start Sunday at Green Bay after taking first-team reps; O'Connell hasn't formally named him. Kyler Murray (hamstring) doubtful, Carson Wentz (ankle) limited.
QB Sam Darnold (quad) out, targeting Week 12 return. Drew Lock (elbow/oblique) limited Thursday; OC Brian Fleury said 'no concerns' and Lock is expected to start at Las Vegas.
QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) on IR, season-ending UCL surgery. Rookie Carson Beck will start Sunday vs Rams per Mike LaFleur.
QB Malik Willis (core) placed on IR. Kyle McCord makes first NFL start Sunday at Indianapolis.
QB Lamar Jackson (thumb) had surgery, expected out 6-10 weeks per Jesse Minter. Jacoby Brissett expected to start Monday vs Chargers.

MIN.text: QB Kirk Cousins expected to start Sunday at Green Bay after taking first-team reps; O'Connell hasn't formally named him. Kyler Murray (hamstring) doubtful, Carson Wentz (ankle) limited.
TE T.J. Hockenson (wrist/chest) and LB Blake Cashman (concussion) did not practice Thursday; both questionable vs Packers.

SEA.text: QB Sam Darnold (quad) out, targeting Week 12 return. Drew Lock (elbow/oblique) limited Thursday; OC Brian Fleury said 'no concerns' and Lock is expected to start at Las Vegas.
OL: LT Charles Cross (ankle, limited Thursday) and G Quenton Nelson (knee, minor procedure) both doubtful; G Anthony Bradford (knee) questionable.

ARI.text: QB Gardner Minshew (elbow) on IR, season-ending UCL surgery. Rookie Carson Beck will start Sunday vs Rams per Mike LaFleur.
OL: C Hjalte Froholdt (concussion) and G Jon Gaines II (ankle) out vs Rams. S Andrew Wingard (groin) DNP Thursday. WR Michael Wilson (neck) on IR.

MIA.text: QB Malik Willis (core) placed on IR. Kyle McCord makes first NFL start Sunday at Indianapolis.
C Aaron Brewer (concussion) ruled out vs Colts; WR Chris Bell (knee) unlikely to play. DT Zach Sieler (biceps) on IR.

BAL.text: QB Lamar Jackson (thumb) had surgery, expected out 6-10 weeks per Jesse Minter. Jacoby Brissett expected to start Monday vs Chargers.
G Olaivavega Ioane (knee) questionable; S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee) limited Thursday after missing last game; WR Rashod Bateman (calf) limited.

LV.text: QB Fernando Mendoza takes over as starter Sunday vs Seahawks after Raiders traded Kirk Cousins to Minnesota; Aidan O'Connell now QB2.

CLE.text: QB Deshaun Watson (concussion) will start Sunday vs Texans, Browns announced Wednesday; Shedeur Sanders, who started Week 9, returns to backup.
WR Denzel Boston (toe) returned to practice Friday. CB Denzel Ward, LBs Carson Schwesinger and Quincy Williams limited; S Ronnie Hickman in concussion protocol.

KC.text: QB Patrick Mahomes (right elbow/knee) reports limited swelling and pain, in line to start Sunday at Atlanta. OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) missed a second straight practice.

LAC.text: WR Ladd McConkey among 9 Chargers who did not practice Thursday. QB Justin Herbert (finger) no longer on injury report for Monday at Baltimore.

NO.text: C Erik McCoy (biceps) doubtful, out 'for a little bit' per Kellen Moore. OTs Taliese Fuaga, Kelvin Banks Jr. and G David Edwards limited Thursday.
RB Travis Etienne Jr. practiced for a second straight day ahead of Panthers game.

IND.text: OT Jalen Travis (knee) doubtful. Colts traded WRs Josh Downs and Keenan Allen Tuesday.

GB.text: LB Zaire Franklin (shin) doubtful; G Sean Rhyan (ankle) DNP Thursday; OT Travis Glover (knee) and G Aaron Banks (knee/hip) limited vs Vikings.

CAR.text: LB Bobby Okereke (foot) ruled out vs Saints. LB Jaelan Phillips and CB Will Lee III (hamstring) questionable after missing last game. CB Jaycee Horn on IR.

PIT.text: DT Derrick Harmon returned to practice from injured reserve Wednesday ahead of Bengals game.

BUF.text: OL: OT Spencer Brown (ankle) had a setback; OTs Dion Dawkins (ribs), Alec Anderson (ankle) and C Connor McGovern (neck) questionable. CB Christian Benford (wrist) limited.

NE.text: C Ben Brown and CB Carlton Davis (knees) out vs Lions; WR A.J. Brown, RB Rhamondre Stevenson and S Kevin Byard among nine questionable.

DET.text: Secondary: CB D.J. Reed and S Kerby Joseph ruled out vs Patriots in Munich; C Cade Mays also out. WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) questionable, limited Friday.
QB Jared Goff (chest) practiced fully Thursday ahead of Patriots game in Munich.

LA.text: WR: Puka Nacua (knee/MCL) placed on IR Thursday; Davante Adams (hamstring, IR) targeting return after Nov. 25. G Steve Avila (hamstring) questionable.
CB Trent McDuffie (back) DNP Thursday after missing last game; DE Myles Garrett (knee) limited Thursday.

HOU.text: LB Azeez Al-Shaair (groin/personal) absent again Thursday. RB Woody Marks (knee) back at practice Friday; DEs Danielle Hunter and Will Anderson Jr. limited.

JAX.text: WR Jakobi Meyers (ankle) and DE Travon Walker (ribs) limited Thursday. C Robert Hainsey (concussion) and G Ezra Cleveland (knee) questionable.

SF.text: Secondary: starting CBs Deommodore Lenoir (foot) and Renardo Green (back) remain out of practice. LT Trent Williams (shoulder) limited Thursday.

NYJ.text: WR Garrett Wilson (concussion) has one protocol step left; Aaron Glenn expects him to clear before Sunday vs Bills.

DAL.text: WR George Pickens (hamstring) moved well Thursday, a positive sign per Schottenheimer; LB DeMarvion Overshown full participant.

TEN.text: LBs Anthony Hill Jr. and Cody Barton out vs Jaguars; G Peter Skoronski (hamstring) and WR Carnell Tate (shoulder) also ruled out.
